coverageNotes: The Illinois State Board of Elections public root and general-election candidate-list pages returned HTTP 403 with the statement: Please contact the site owner for access. The statewide certified candidate file and statewide measure list remain unacquired; this is an access gap, not a statement that certification has not occurred.
Lake and DuPage County referenda publications list county and local questions. They do not establish the statewide measure inventory; no statewide measure absence is claimed.

Named write-in candidates on county-only filing lists are not included in statewide or district-wide contests because their qualification beyond the publishing county has not been established. The statewide write-in inventory remains unacquired. The unnamed write-in lines and No Candidate placeholders on specimen ballots are not candidate names.

The Chicago Board's February 25, 2020 and May 11, 2021 meeting minutes confirm its Azure Government website hosting and storage. Publisher-produced HTML from its .gov site directly loads a logo from the same cboeprod.blob.core.usgovcloudapi.net host as the candidate PDF; that HTML returned HTTP 404 and is described separately from the positive source receipts.
Governor and Lieutenant Governor are one vote-for-one ticket contest on the certified Rockford specimen ballot. Each ticket retains both printed candidate names and their shared party.

Candidate inventories cover each whole district. Countywide master ballots support completeness only for districts wholly within that county, as established by the official Census district/county relationship table.

Whole-district candidate inventories remain unverified for: FOR STATE SENATOR THIRTY-SIXTH LEGISLATIVE DISTRICT; FOR REPRESENTATIVE IN THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY SEVENTY-FIRST REPRESENTATIVE DISTRICT; REPRESENTATIVE DISTRICT SEVENTY-NINTH THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY FOR REPRESENTATIVE IN; FOR REPRESENTATIVE IN THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY ONE HUNDRED AND EIGHTEENTH REPRESENTATIVE DISTRICT. Their acquired candidate facts remain held while complete official district inventories are sought.

Senate 36 and House 71 span Henry, Knox, McDonough, Mercer, Rock Island and Warren counties. Countywide general-election masters agree on the acquired nominees, but the Mercer master remains unacquired. The McDonough master was read through its official HTTP county door; the corresponding HTTPS read returned 503. The public Henry candidate-filings service has no acquired government-delegation link, so it does not close the district coverage gap.

House 79 spans Cook, Grundy, Kankakee and Will counties. Official Kankakee and Grundy countywide masters supply the acquired candidate facts; complete Cook and Will county components remain unacquired. Kankakee government links a primary-election results service; no government link to the separate hosted general-election candidate roster was acquired.

House 118 spans Alexander, Jackson, Pulaski, Union and Williamson counties. The acquired Williamson ballot supplies candidate facts only. Public Williamson and Pulaski services list primary-election data, Jackson’s acquired November notice lists offices without nominees, the Union public results door returned 500 and its candidate-filings door required login, and Alexander’s acquired clerk page supplied no qualifying general-election inventory. The complete official district candidate set remains unacquired.

All 17 U.S. House districts are acquired. State Senate districts 27 and State House districts 2, 17, 30, 37, 38, 44, 53, 54, 63, 80, 86, 97, 98, 99, 103, 104 remain unacquired after searches of public State Board and county nominee inventories.
The Chicago Board candidate list is dated August 19, 2026 and lists whole district offices intersecting Chicago. Candidate rows are included; Removed and Withdrawn rows are excluded.

BA-01: Brown and Sangamon official November 3 sample ballots add House District 99 and three countywide offices in each county. Every named candidate and printed party in those races is preserved; No Candidate and blank write-in lines are not people. County board, regional education, judicial and other local contests remain standing acquisition work.
